## HyperTile 0.4.2
- Prices show in your currency (€, £, ₹, C$, A$, ¥), matching checkout
## HyperTile 0.4.1
- HyperTile now speaks Spanish, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese, following your Mac's language - Fixed: if the trackpad stopped reporting in the middle of a swipe (sleep, unplugging it, pausing HyperTile), the sliding desktop picture could stay over the screen. It now springs back and goes away - Default desktop names ("Desktop 2") are translated too
## HyperTile 0.4.0
- Try HyperTile free for 2 days: every feature works from the first launch, with no licence key - Swiping between desktops now follows your fingers and slides, like macOS Spaces; keyboard switches slide too - The desktop map shows each desktop as it really looks, with its name - Name desktops (⌃⌥⌘D, double-click a name); named desktops stay when their windows close - In the map, drag a window onto another to swap them, or onto another desktop to move it - ⌃⌥⌘W, or a stack's badge, shows windows hidden behind others so you can bring one to the front - Dragging a window highlights the tile it will land in, and the window there slides into your old tile so you can see the swap - Smoother swipe: follows your fingers frame by frame and keeps their speed when you let go - Windows go back to their desktops after HyperTile restarts, or after a pause - The window picker can move a window to another desktop, float, fill the screen, minimize or close it - Optional Screen Recording permission for real window pictures in the map and swipe
## HyperTile 0.3.0
The first public release.
- Tiles every window automatically, in Grid, Columns, Rows or Side layouts - Optional virtual desktops, with a four-finger swipe between them - Keyboard shortcuts to swap, focus, float and resize windows - Windows with a minimum or fixed size get room in the layout - Picks up trackpads connected after launch, and after sleep - Uses less energy when nothing on screen changes - Offers to move itself to Applications - Licence activation in the welcome tour and Settings → Licence
